verdict.rationale: Kit documents dedicated bulk API processing: bulk subscriber creation, bulk custom-field value updates across many subscribers in one request, and bulk custom-field creation. Large batches run asynchronously with a callback_url, and batch stats cover a page of broadcasts in a single request. Broadcasts can also target whole segments or tags at once. However, bulk support covers only 'some common use cases' and requires OAuth rather than API keys. Missing for 10: bulk coverage beyond select endpoints (e.g. bulk tagging or deletes), evidence that the Kit MCP exposes bulk actions to AI clients, independent or hands-on corroboration.
